triage.kind_span: hereby offers to purchase up to $60,000,000 of its outstanding 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022

subject_names.span: Prospect Capital Corporation (Name of Subject Company (Issuer) and Filing Person (Offeror))

subject_tickers.span: Our common stock is traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “PSEC.”

security_class.span: 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022 (Title of Class of Securities)

price_basis.span: for cash in an amount equal to $1,025.00 per $1,000 principal amount of Notes purchased (exclusive of accrued and unpaid interest on such Notes)

commencement_date.span: The Tender Offer commenced on August 26, 2021 and will expire on the Expiration Date

trigger_origin.span: The purpose of the Tender Offer is to reduce the principal amount of outstanding Notes, which mature on July 15, 2022.

notes: Issuer tender offer by Prospect Capital Corporation, a BDC ('We have elected to be regulated as a business development company under the Investment Company Act of 1940'), for its own 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022, not for shares; recorded as cef_tender with security_class 'notes' since that is the only kind for an issuer tender. Price is fixed at $1,025.00 per $1,000 principal plus accrued interest (no NAV basis). Size is stated as up to $60,000,000 aggregate principal of $111,055,000 outstanding (as of August 25, 2021); size_shares is null because the size is a principal amount, not a share count, and size_pct_outstanding is null because the percent would need arithmetic (about 54%). subject_tickers: the Notes are not listed on any exchange; PSEC is the ticker printed for the company's common stock. expiration_date: the filing states 12:00 midnight New York City time on September 24, 2021, i.e. one minute after 11:59 p.m. on September 23, 2021; the stated date September 24 is used. trigger_origin 'other': stated purpose is to reduce outstanding Notes maturing July 15, 2022 (liability management). Conditions: 'other' covers the trustee/security-registrar objection condition and the competing-transaction condition; board_discretion maps the company's 'reasonable judgment' material-adverse-change condition. Not conditioned on a minimum tender; funded by Credit Facility borrowings and cash (no financing condition stated). No results in this filing.
